tool_args.rationale: The pilot ends at H=0.48, far short of the target H=24.2. A slow-horizon observation directly constrains the proposed adaptation and reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-exponential model from the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon rows do not reliably identify both time scales or the long-horizon reversal.
Further short-horizon detail is less informative about the slow component at the target horizon.
It does not resolve the horizon-dependent mechanism.
